title: CoLA: Cross-Modal Low-rank Adaptation for Multimodal Downstream Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2604.03314v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Foundation models have revolutionized AI, but adapting them efficiently for multimodal tasks, particularly in dual-stream architectures composed of unimodal encoders, such as DINO and BERT, remains a significant challenge. ParameterEfficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods like LowRank Adaptation (LoRA) enable lightweight adaptation, yet they operate in isolation within each modality, limiting their ability in capturing cross-modal interactions. In this paper, we take a step in bridging this gap with Cross-Modal LowRank Adaptation (CoLA), a novel PEFT framework that extends LoRA by introducing a dedicated inter-modal adaptation pathway alongside the standard intra-modal one. This dual-path design enables CoLA to adapt unimodal foundation models to multimodal tasks effectively, without interference between modality-specific and crossmodal learning. translated_title: CoLA：面向多模态下游任务的跨模态低秩适配
translated_abstract: 摘要：基础模型已经彻底改变了人工智能领域，但如何高效地将它们适配到多模态任务中，特别是在由单模态编码器（如DINO和BERT）组成的双流架构中，仍然是一个重大挑战。参数高效微调（PEFT）方法，如低秩适配（LoRA），能够实现轻量级适配，但它们在各模态内独立运作，限制了其捕捉跨模态交互的能力。在本文中，我们通过引入跨模态低秩适配（CoLA）来弥合这一差距，这是一种新颖的PEFT框架，通过引入专门的模态间适配路径和标准的模态内适配路径来扩展LoRA。这种双路径设计使CoLA能够有效地将单模态基础模型适配到多模态任务中，同时避免模态特定学习和跨模态学习之间的干扰。我们在多种视觉-语言任务（如RefCOCO、RefCOCO+、RefCOCOg）以及一个
tldr: 本文提出CoLA，一种通过双路径设计（模态内和跨模态）扩展LoRA的PEFT框架，有效捕捉跨模态交互，提升多模态任务适配性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CoLA, a PEFT framework extending LoRA with a dual-path design (intra-modal and cross-modal), effectively capturing cross-modal interactions to improve multimodal task adaptation.
